title.narrative: Focused HIV prevention, treatment and care in Sudan - Sudan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Sudan, HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Sudan)This program has the following goals: To halt the further spread of HIV among the Sudanese population and maintain HIV prevalence rates below 2.5% among all most-at-risk populations and below 0.3% among the general population by 2020. To improve the quality of life, health and wellbeing of people living with HIV by providing universal access to comprehensive quality HIV treatment, care and support services. The objectives of this program are: Effective availability, sharing and utilisation of strategic information on HIV/AIDS to guide the implementation of evidence-informed policies, programmes and services. HIV transmission among key and vulnerable populations' sexual networks reduced through increasing their access and utilization of HIV prevention services. To scale up and improve the quality of key HIV-prevention programmes and services for the general population. To increase ART coverage and improve quality of treatment services. Positive health, dignity and prevention for PLHIV
